_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
In him was life, and the life was the light of all people.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
How beautiful the feet that bring good news of peace.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Before the mountains, before the light, before the first morning — the Word was.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
And the Word, who flung the stars, has come close enough to touch.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not put it out.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace upon grace.
The Word became flesh, full of grace and truth!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The Word who made the light comes close enough to touch.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
The light shines; the darkness cannot win.
The Word became flesh and lived among us.
From his fullness, grace upon grace.
The Word became flesh. Glory to God! Amen.
